free.a: Yes. Most courses are free — just sign up and enroll.

attempts.q: How many times can I take a test?
attempts.a: The teacher decides: attempts can be limited or unlimited.

teacher.q: How do I become a teacher?
teacher.a: Choose the «Teacher» role when signing up — the course builder opens after you confirm your email.

mobile.q: Does it work on a phone?
mobile.a: Yes, all pages, tests and calls work on mobile devices.

welcome.finalText: Create an account in a minute and pick your first course.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.intro: This page explains what data the platform collects and why. We don’t sell data and don’t use advertising cookies.
privacy.accountText: Your email, first and last name are needed to sign in, for confirmation emails and certificates. Learning progress, test results and chat messages are stored so you can continue learning on any device.
privacy.emailsText: We send emails to confirm your address, to recover your password and — unless you turn it off in your profile — notifications about requests, new lessons and test results.
privacy.analyticsText: Only with your consent do we enable Google Analytics 4 to see which pages and features are used. IP addresses are anonymised; emails and names are never sent to analytics. You can opt out at any time — clear the site data in your browser and the banner will appear again.
privacy.cookiesText: Session cookies are needed to sign in. Your theme, language and analytics consent choices are kept in the browser’s local storage or in cookies.

consent.text: We use Google Analytics to understand how to improve the platform. There are no advertising cookies.
